caption: The video showcases a Kärcher steam mop being worked across a glossy beige ceramic-tile floor marked by pale grout lines. The tool's dark rectangular head, fitted with a white microfiber pad, rides on a vertical brown handle accented by a small yellow clip. Throughout the excerpt the head glides over the tiles, first sitting low in the frame, then traveling toward the upper edge where the handle is partly cropped from view, and afterward easing back down to a near position. A soft plume of steam curls up around the head, most visible during the earlier pass and noticeably thinner as the clip progresses. The swivel joint tilts the head slightly at times, then squares it again as it moves. A wet, reflective strip trails across the surface, reshaping itself with each pass of the pad. A bright window reflection pools on the left tile.
relations: The mop head glides across the tiles, rising toward the upper frame edge then easing back down.
A steam plume curls around the head, thinning noticeably as the pass progresses.
A wet reflective strip trails behind the pad, reshaping with each new pass.
The swivel joint tilts the head slightly during travel, then squares it again.
